description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Heart to Heart Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Heart to Heart Mode
description.text: Casts Time Permitted after using Reason to Live, sets Time Permitted level to 0 after using a Fire ability
